newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav May producer prices 0.3 pct up on April.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav May producer prices 0.3 pct up on April.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office reported on Thursday the following economic indicator details.
YUGOSLAV PRODUCER PRICES MAY 97 APR 97 MAY 96
NOTES -- May PPI rose 19.2 percent against the average 1996 and was 5.1 percent up on December last year.
Cumulative January-May PPI rose 27.7 percent against the same period last year and was 18 percent up against the average in 1996.
Figures refer to Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
